metadata.page_title: Bend & Snap Count vs Two Buck Luck matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Bend & Snap Count won by 2.1. Bend & Snap Count left 4.0 lineup points on the table, while Two Buck Luck left 21.6.
summary.historical_summary: Bend & Snap Count is 22-20 against Two Buck Luck across 42 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Two Buck Luck
summary.winner_reason: Bend & Snap Count won by 2.1 after scoring +18.8 against projection. The leading starters were Joe Burrow (38.4) and Cam Skattebo (32.2).
summary.loser_reason: Two Buck Luck lost by 2.1 even while beating projection by 14.3 points. Malik Nabers scored 3.4. Its best legal lineup added 21.6, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
